claims.claim: This his a motor speed reducer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a gearbox/reducer-looking unit, but there is no readable nameplate or clear input/output specification to confirm it is a motor speed reducer (gear ratio, input type, compatibility).

risks.risk: Unknown model/gear ratio and mounting interface: wrong ratio or wrong shaft/flange pattern can make it unusable for the buyer’s motor/application.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/label (manufacturer, model, gear ratio, input/output RPM, shaft size) and a close-up of the mounting bolt pattern/flange dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used speed reducer with unknown ratio and unknown compatibility (worst-case: may require parts/machining to fit).

risks.risk: Condition/gear wear or bearing noise: photo cannot confirm smooth operation, backlash, or bearing health.
risks.proof: Video clip of it running under load (or at least spin test) showing smooth rotation and no abnormal noise, plus a short run-time.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven for working condition (worst-case: needs servicing/overhaul).

risks.risk: Oil leakage or seal failure: photo cannot confirm whether seals are intact.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seals/gaskets and the underside for any wetness, plus a wipe-and-check after a short run.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially leaking/needs reseal (worst-case: reseal/replace seals).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/incorrect coupling: reducer may be sold without required coupling, key, bolts, or oil fill/cap.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included (coupling/shaft/key/bolts/cap) laid out, and a photo of the oil fill/drain points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown included parts (worst-case: buyer must source missing parts).

proof_requests: Clear nameplate photo (manufacturer + model + gear ratio + input/output RPM + serial number).
Close-up of input shaft/connection and output flange (dimensions, bolt pattern, keyway/shaft diameter).
Video of it running (or at least a spin test) showing smooth operation and no grinding/whining.
Photos of seals/gaskets and underside for leakage; show oil fill/drain points.
response.reason: The photo shows a gearbox/reducer, but the critical pricing details (model/gear ratio, mounting compatibility, and working condition) are not readable or verifiable remotely. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
